API Key missing. To get your API Key please:

1. Access https://www.mailermailer.com -> Account -> Extras -> API Key on your mobile device

2. Copy the key to the cliboard. NOTE: it may help to zoom the browser view.

3. Run ScanBizCards

4. In the ScanBizCards Settings -> Mailer Mailer Settings, paste your API Key
